chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q3 Short FRQ (5 points) — Set 2: AD-AS & automatic stabilizers
chunks.content: AP Macroeconomics FRQ 3 (Short), 5 points, one per element. Set 2 answer key highlights: draw a correctly labeled AD-AS graph showing PL1 and the relevant equilibrium/shift; explain that as real income rises, tax revenues increase automatically (automatic stabilizers); plus related state/explain elements on the resulting effects. Same 5-point structure as Set 1. Common failure: unlabeled AD-AS graph; describing automatic stabilizers without the income→tax-revenue mechanism.
